lf-sort-film.description: An animated, scrubbable trace of the merge sort Rust shipped in 1.15, drawn as one SVG in the page's palette: the slice, the scratch buffer, and the run stack with its collapse() checks. Its playhead output is the slice.rs lines the current step executes, which lf-code excerpts that follow it mark. The current step, each slot of the slice, the scratch lane, the run stack and each collapse() clause are commentable visual parts.
